about: Method B as built on 10 Nov 2026 (release 41d06fa3ac36): A with 15 AI materials picked (11 of them drawn by the code), 13 landmark portraits and A's leaf-clump crowns. From the build's own check stages (python -m v2.build test g1 with V2_ART=b); thresholds are the build's, unchanged. The G1 report did not run because check_shadows failed, so this file stands in for g1_test_b.json.

brief_5_no_baked_shadows.what: materials darker or lighter in the 3D shadow of the photo's sun than lit next to it by more than 5% (median luminance inside surfaces)
